name: multi_edit
description: Apply several anchored substring replacements to one workspace-relative file in a single atomic write. Edits apply in order against the running result; each anchor must occur exactly once at its turn. If any edit fails, nothing is written and the failing edit index is reported.

path.description: Workspace-relative file to edit. Must exist.

anchor.description: Literal substring to find. Must match exactly once when this edit runs. No regex.

replacement.description: Substitute for the anchor. May be empty.

edits.description: Ordered edits. Later edits see earlier replacements.
